body:
The [first native response model screen](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/c728d6179075569a82cac70649460cbf34b1bd2d/experiments/2026-10-25_0630_codex_native-contrast-screen/README.md) is complete, with the source recipe held fixed. It failed its prespecified biological gate: validation sequence RMSE 0.317328 versus zero 0.317216; test 0.423308 versus zero 0.424407, only 0.259% improvement with a paired component-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.247%, 0.449%]. Outputs have less than 1% of target SD. Training-only CV selects strong shrinkage (alpha 100). All active coefficients, source-linked predictions, metrics and bootstrap draws independently replay; this does not by itself show that the source is bad or that biology lacks sequence information.

The next diagnostic is restricted to training components: within-arm ratio variability, leave-one-acquisition sensitivity and dependent split-acquisition concordance. It will not invent biological replicates from Cont/KD numbering or retune the inspected outer groups. The existing unresolved acquisition-to-physical-specimen/independent-experiment mapping therefore remains an important data limitation; exact mapping, if source-backed, should remain queryable in the common material-context system.

PR841 is merged and all hosted checks passed. Source 2.0.37 is published with exact tested PyPI bytes verified. The recipe 2.0.38 tested release40169827556 is still running. A documented pre-fit execution-order amendment used identical merged/full-CI code locally while packaging continued, without changing data, model selection or success criteria. Keep this issue open for the outstanding source-context and biological-validation work.
